name: The Lost Caravan
summary: Watcher Biggs needs the caravan's reagents recovered after the Lost Ones carry a wagon north to the Fallow Sanctuary. The chest holds supplies for the wizards of Nethergarde Keep.

sections.title: The Stolen Wagon
sections.body: Watcher Biggs was knocked senseless when the Lost Ones attacked the caravan. Before he fell, he saw them drag one of its wagons north to the Fallow Sanctuary, their village. A chest of reagents was aboard, prized by the wizards of Nethergarde Keep for their studies. Biggs asks you to find the chest and carry its contents back.

sections.title: Word from Biggs
sections.body: When you bring the reagents back, Watcher Biggs is pleased. The wizards of Nethergarde can continue their work, though Biggs does not know what that work is. He knows it concerns the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands and matters greatly to the Alliance's security.

faq.answer: Watcher Biggs lost one of the caravan's wagons to the Lost Ones and wants its reagents recovered.

faq.q: Where did the Lost Ones take the caravan chest?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs saw the wagon hauled north to the Fallow Sanctuary, the Lost Ones' village, with the chest aboard.
The wizards of Nethergarde Keep depend on the reagents for their studies.

faq.q: What comes after recovering the chest?
faq.answer: Driftwood follows once Watcher Biggs has the reagents.
